newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Volkswagen is top China foreign firm.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Volkswagen is top China foreign firm.

text.p: Shanghai Volkswagen remained top of the list of foreign-invested firms in China in 1995 for the fifth straight year on the basis of annual sales, the China Daily said on Saturday.
The joint venture Shanghai Volkswagen, a subsidiary of Volkswagen AG, recorded annual sales of 18.4 billion ($2.2 billion) in 1995, the newspaper said. It did not give a figure for profits.
Total assets of the 500 largest foreign-invested firms in China leapt by 39 percent last year to 350 billion yuan from 1994. Combined sales rose 43 percent to 367.4 billion yuan.
The number of enterprises with annual sales of more than 1.0 billion yuan rose to 89 from 57, the newspaper said.
Among the top 500, some 90 percent were in profit, it said.
Also among the top 500, the number of Japanese-invested firms had risen to 66 from 59, while German firms had reached 14 from 12 and U.S.-invested firms had increased to 51 from 50.

Most such firms were concentrated in coastal regions, accounting for 91 percent of the top 500 foreign-invested firms. Most were in southern Guangdong province followed by Shanghai and neighbouring Jiangsu province, the newspaper said.
